# Seven-day per-minute click query

> A `ClickHouse` query that sums clicks per minute for one link code over the last 7 days, oldest minute first.

_Part of [Owner-only click stats for the last 7 days](link-stats-endpoint.md)_

This query is the last step of `stats`, the method in [`ShareLinkService`](link-click-analytics.md) that shows a link owner their click numbers. Before it runs, `stats` looks the link up with `resolve` and throws a not-found error if the link is missing or belongs to someone else. See [Owner-only click stats for the last 7 days](link-stats-endpoint.md) for the ownership check. The query reads the `ClickHouse` table `link_clicks_minute`. It keeps only rows for the given code and only minutes from the last 7 days (`now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY`). It groups rows by `minute`, adds up `clicks` for each minute, and sorts by `minute` so the oldest comes first. The code goes in as a named query parameter (`{code:String}`), not glued into the SQL text. Each row comes back as two strings: the minute and the click count. The clicks being counted come from the `link.clicked` events described in [Link click attribution and stats](link-click-analytics.md).

**Look at:** [share-link.service.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/marketing/application/share-link.service.ts)

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| database | `link_clicks_minute` | Read with a `ClickHouse` `SELECT` that sums `clicks` per `minute` for one `code` over the last 7 days. |

## Watch out

- The `ClickHouse` client returns `minute` and `clicks` as strings (the type is `{ minute: string; clicks: string }`), so convert `clicks` to a number if you do math on it.
- The source shows only that `link_clicks_minute` is read. Nothing in this file shows how it is filled, so check the projector topic for that.
- Minutes with no clicks are not returned, because the query only groups rows that exist. The result can have gaps.
- A missing link and a link owned by someone else both give the same `Link not found` error, so the caller can't tell which one happened.
